factorial.extension_rule: If any common-user validation view has its best NDCG@20 in epochs 26-30, extend BOTH label models to 60. Otherwise finish both at 30. No test-based decisions.
factorial.training_users: Intersection of users eligible under both labels, determined using training data only
factorial.items: Same sorted vocabulary of all training exposures under both labels
factorial.samples_per_epoch: Minimum of the two common-cohort positive-pair counts, identical update budget
factorial.primary_evaluation: Same fixed epochs and intersection of users with targets in all four validation views; report whole available validation cohorts separately
factorial.secondary_selection: Per label best common-user random-exposure validation NDCG@20; all other views use that SAME checkpoint

scope: Validation-only implementation alignment and label/exposure diagnosis. Original source, prior experiments and current task test labels remain unchanged. No automatic sampling or propagation innovation is added in this sequence.
